notes.title: V0.20.0 – First Steps Toward Player Progression
notes.notes:
This update kicks off the foundation for long-term progression. Players can now earn coins by playing matches, build up their collection through Cube Draft and the Shop, and slowly see their library grow. It’s the start of a proper collection system — still plenty of placeholder visuals and rough edges, but it’s the first step toward building out meaningful progression and engagement.


V0.20.0

GAMEPLAY
Attack animations now cancel early if the attacking creature dies in combat. The creature is sent directly to the graveyard instead of returning to its board slot first.
Players now earn coins after completing matches. (Win: 50 coins. Defeat: 10 coins)

CUBE DRAFT
Cube draft now has an entry fee of 600 coins. 
Cards drafted during a run of cube draft are now added to the player’s collection.
Cube draft rewards coins for each win on run completion.

ECONOMY
Player’s start with an initial balance of 1,400 coins. 

DECKBUILDER
The deckbuilder now displays how many copies of each card the player has collected.

SHOP
The shop UI is still a work in progress, but all core functionality is in place.
Integrated shop with the game’s economy backend.
Players can now purchase individual cards to add to their collections using coins.

-Fixed a bug where a burned Ramper would die and give full mana on the same turn. All Start of Turn keywords are now  processed after energy refill.

-Fixed a bugged interaction where Ring of Arcane Echoes would trigger more than once before destroying itself when receiving non-combat damage more than once in short periods of time.
-Fixed an issue where, at the end of turn, if creatures didn’t attack, their outlines would re-enable incorrectly at the start of the opponent’s turn.

notes.title: The first Playtest Branch build is live!
notes.notes:
Welcome, thank you for being part of this early stages. This is a very early look at the game—many assets are placeholder, and core systems are still evolving.
You’ll likely run into rough edges, bugs, or weird interactions… and that’s exactly the point.

If you see something odd, broken, or even just a little off, let me know. Your feedback is incredibly valuable at this stage.

Join our Discord to share feedback, report issues, and connect with other players.
Together, we’re shaping what Songs of the Broken Crowns will become.

👉 discord.gg/Z7ztVntY3Q

Thanks for helping shape this project from the ground up!
